item.title: Tell HN: YC companies scrape GitHub activity, send spam emails to users
item.description:
📝 org>Subject: Mikołaj, think you'd like this[snip]Hi Mikołaj,I found your GitHub and thought you might like what we're building. These emails indicate that those companies scrape people's Github activity, and if they notice users contributing to repos in their field of business, send marketing emails to those users without receiving their consent. My guess is that they use commit metadata for this purpose.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47163885

item.title: Men in their 50s may be aging faster due to toxic 'forever chemicals'
item.description:
📝 Earlier studies show women appear to eliminate certain PFAS faster than men due to pregnancy, breastfeeding and menstrual blood loss. Studies have also found the difference in PFAS accumulation between women and men narrows after menopause. Mario Tama/Getty Images Toxic ‘forever’ chemicals found in excessive levels in global groundwater.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnn.com/2026/02/26/health/forever-chemicals-aging-men-wellness
